end.parentNote: Anika practised sorting objects by whether they roll or stack, using a tin as the example. Asha used the tin’s curved side and position to explain that it can roll on its side and stack upright, but Anika still said only balls roll at the end. At home, gently test a ball, bottle, and tin by placing each on its side and upright, then ask what happens.
